package.description: Discord bot that sends notifications for Fire Weather Warnings across the US

en-US.description: Discord bot that sends notifications for Fire Weather Warnings across the US
en-US.longDescription: A Discord bot that automatically sends notifications for fire weather alerts anywhere in the United States. The bot checks the National Weather Service every 60 seconds and posts alerts to your Discord channel with details about the alert type, affected area, severity, and expiration time.
en-US.name: FFW-BOT
